model.foundation_stiffness: K_w = k * ∫ N^T N dA (2x2 Gauss)
model.domain_scaling: quarter model, half width = 10 l, graded axis (beta=4)

reference.external_anchor: Hetényi, M. (1946) Beams on Elastic Foundation, Univ. of Michigan Press — infinite plate: w(r) = -P/(2πkl²)·kei(r/l); w(0)=P/(8√(Dk)); finite simply supported beam: Fourier-sine (Hetényi's method of end conditioning for SS ends).
reference.finite_plate_series: Timoshenko & Woinowsky-Krieger (1959) Navier double series with foundation term k in the modal denominator

regime_diagnostic.note: error grows with mesh refinement towards the converged Mindlin shear offset; expected O((t/l)^2) above the Kirchhoff solution
